# formal_skill (Resource)

Registering a Skill in the Formal Catalog from its `SKILL.md`. Skill names are unique, and changing `skill_md` replaces the skill.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One skill per skills/<name>/SKILL.md file.
resource "formal_skill" "repo" {
  for_each = fileset("${path.module}/skills", "*/SKILL.md")
  skill_md = file("${path.module}/skills/${each.value}")
}

# Only release managers can use the release-notes skill.
resource "formal_policy" "release_notes_skill" {
  name        = "Skill access: release-notes"
  description = "Only release managers can use the release-notes skill."
  status      = "active"
  module      = <<-EOT
    package formal.v2

    import future.keywords.if
    import future.keywords.in

    request := {
      "action": "block",
      "type": "block_with_formal_message",
      "reason": "Only release managers can use the release-notes skill.",
    } if {
      input.resource.technology == "llm"
      some skill in input.llm.loaded_skills
      skill.name == "${formal_skill.repo["release-notes/SKILL.md"].name}"
      not "release-managers" in input.user.groups
    }
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `skill_md` (String) Contents of the `SKILL.md` file, including its `name` and `description` frontmatter. Formatting-only changes are ignored.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the Skill, from the `SKILL.md` frontmatter.
- `id` (String) The ID of this Skill.
- `name` (String) Name of the Skill, from the `SKILL.md` frontmatter.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Skills are imported by name.
terraform import 'formal_skill.repo["release-notes/SKILL.md"]' release-notes
```
